parameters.content:
## SMS qualification agent (generic)
Twilio inbound SMS: POST https://rankn8n.com/webhook/grorank-sms-agent

This workflow contains NO business-specific text. Everything (business name, services, hours, required fields, special rules) comes from the lead's own saved state, which the Missed Call workflow's 'Client Config' node writes when a lead is created. A text from a number with no active lead is ignored.

Conversation state: data table grorank_sms_leads (key = business number + caller number). Lead dashboard: Google Sheet 'GroRank Missed Call' > 'Missed Call' (one row per lead, updated in place).

Qualification ends automatically when all required fields are captured, the customer asks for a person, sends STOP, or maxTurns is reached.

Manual Demo Test never sends SMS. Edit 'Demo Test Message' body/from to simulate a reply; run the Missed Call workflow first for that number so an active lead exists.

nodes.name: Locate Lead Row
nodes.notes: Finds the ONE active lead row (same Business Number + Caller Number, Status New/Qualifying). Completed leads are never touched.
